headline: A joint resolution set noon on January 4, 2016, as the time Congress would begin its second session of the 114th Congress.
what_it_does: This law sets the date and time for the second session of the 114th Congress to start. It says the session convenes at noon on January 4, 2016. It is a procedural measure about scheduling Congress's own work.
when_it_takes_effect: The session it sets was scheduled to begin at noon on January 4, 2016.
